method: per-mutant adversarial semantic review against the frozen base; gates not run

per_mutant.one_sentence_reason: Erasing genericity.excluded_set and flipping excluded_set_status to 'resolved: nothing is excluded' removes the Kerr extendible family that makes the comeager quantifier meaningful, so the class silently becomes the all-AF-data statement that the retained conclusion.known_obstruction and forbidden_strengthenings record as false.

The C2 erasure contradicts the retained known_obstruction, which still says the exact Kerr data admit a C-infinity vacuum extension and that the unqualified statement is false, so the class collapses to a claim the artifact itself refutes.

non_vacuity.status now claims the witness family was constructed and its membership in G verified 'here' with no artifact_refs or proof, contradicting the retained unresolved_items entry 'non-vacuity witness membership in G' and inflating epistemic status.

Dropping 'm_ADM >= 0 by the positive mass theorem' and retaining negative-mass data in the ambient space changes the data/genericity axis and contradicts the retained adm_mass.locator, which states the sign is used precisely to exclude negative-mass data from the ambient space.

The C2 analogue retains negative-mass data in a vacuum AF class whose positivity is a theorem and whose matter/equation slots remain vacuum, silently enlarging the ambient data space and deleting a frozen sign condition.

Lowering the bound to s >= 2 in regularity.data_regularity and regularity_class.sobolev_variant while quantifiers.domains.D0 still fixes s > 5/2 is a direct internal contradiction and admits data below the threshold at which the cited vacuum constraint/MGHD theory is established.

Replacing 'C^k regularity, k >= 3; k is part of the assumption' with 'C^0 only' is an unannounced assumption-axis change that contradicts the retained adm_mass.hypotheses_reconciliation ('i_plus k >= 3 is assumed independently') and changes which data the class admits.

Weakening the WCC i_plus_regularity to C^0 and disclaiming the conformal Einstein equations contradicts the retained i_plus.definition, quantifiers.domains.D3 and i_plus.required_properties, and makes the class's own completion/completeness predicate ill-posed.

data_class.equations becomes Einstein-Maxwell while matter stays none, the constraints stay the vacuum ones, and the conclusion/extension predicate stay vacuum statements, a cross-axis contradiction that imports Maxwell content into a vacuum class.

The WCC analogue couples a massless scalar field into equations while matter is explicitly left at none and the conclusion remains a vacuum WCC statement, importing foreign-family matter content and contradicting the retained vacuum constraints.

The field still requires a Cauchy surface, which is equivalent to global hyperbolicity (and by Geroch gives M diffeomorphic to Sigma x R), so the mathematical class is arguably unchanged; but the added disclaimer 'global hyperbolicity is not assumed' is false and contradicts the retained maximal-globally-hyperbolic-development language, making this a defective reformulation rather than a clean class change.

Declaring two AF ends contradicts the retained slice_topology ('exactly one asymptotically flat end'), topology.forbidden ('more than one asymptotically flat end') and the one-ended data class, and the mutant itself admits the entry is unreconciled.

Weakening quantifiers.negation and its normal form to the existence of one extendible datum contradicts the retained tier_1.genericity_requirement ('One extendible datum is NOT sufficient') and changes the class's falsification condition from non-meagerness to a single counterexample.

The C2 analogue weakens the negation to a single datum while the retained tier_1.genericity_requirement and quantifier structure still demand non-meagerness, leaving the artifact's falsification semantics internally contradicted.

Changing the leading formal quantifier to 'exists (s,delta)' while quantifiers.ordered and quantifier_class still say forall is a direct formal/ordered contradiction and turns the class into a much weaker statement.

Reversing extension_class_containment to E_C2 contains E_{C^1,1} contains E_H2loc contains E_C0 inverts the frozen containment and entailment direction (a C0 metric need not be C2), contradicting the retained one_way_entailments, forbidden_transfers and subsumption_note.

The C2 reversal claims the C2 class requires the lowest regularity and is the strongest, contradicting the retained extension_regularity_exact and one_way_entailments (E_C2 subset E_{C^1,1} subset E_H2loc subset E_C0).

Appending a strictly weaker C2-level statement to equivalent_rephrasings as 'equivalent by the containment of regularity classes' inverts the one-way entailment and contradicts the retained forbidden_weakenings and c0_specific_note.

Deleting conclusion.known_obstruction removes the explicit record that the unqualified statement is false and leaves forbidden_strengthenings' '(false if the Kerr obstruction is as stated)' dangling; the Kerr extendibility fact does survive in genericity.excluded_set, so the class itself is unchanged and this is closer to a documentation omission than a class leak.

Rewriting known_obstruction as 'no obstruction recorded' and demoting the generic quantifier to a 'continuity convention' is a false status claim, because the retained genericity.excluded_set still records the exactly extendible Kerr family whose extension forces the generic quantifier.

Marking the Kerr provenance source 'verified' with an identifier while the top-level citation_status stays unverified, no retrieval date is given, and known_status_signals still calls that same arXiv pointer a worker-supplied unresolved hint is a per-source verification inflation.

Promoting conclusion.epistemic_status to conditional_theorem with no artifact_refs contradicts the retained claim_promotion ('epistemic_status=open_problem; theorem requires artifact_refs with a checked proof') and the top-level epistemic_status.
The C2 inflation claims conditional_theorem while the retained claim_promotion and known_status still record open_problem and no proof artifact or artifact_refs are supplied.

Accepting a visible incomplete geodesic as a tier-1 falsifier imports the WCC falsifier into an SCC class and contradicts the retained visibility role/reason, the wrong-family schema falsifier, and the forbidden WCC-to-SCC transfer.

Redefining i_plus.completeness_definition so that future-completeness of null geodesic generators is 'not required' changes the WCC class's own conclusion predicate and contradicts the retained statement_formal clause (ii), required_properties and 'dropping I+ completeness' weakening ban.

The informal replacement drops the finite-affine-length singularity qualifier and the single-q J^-(q) tail structure, re-opening the R1 F02 conflation the retained must_not_conflate forbids; but the precise predicate remains fixed in visibility.definition and quantifiers.formal, so the class can still be read as unchanged and the leak claim is arguable.

Deleting falsifier.schema_falsifiers removes the schema's declared class-inflation, wrong-family, smuggled-regularity and weaker-evidence disqualifiers without altering any class field or asserting a falsehood, so it is a real loss of schema self-protection but not itself a class change.

Moving comeagerness to the unconstrained weighted Sobolev product, where the base explicitly warns X_vac is meager, makes the generic set vacuous and contradicts the retained generic_set and D1 definitions on the constraint manifold.

Dropping the vacuum condition (and one-endedness) from D2 admits non-vacuum data while data_class.matter/equations, genericity.ambient_space and the conclusion all remain vacuum, so the quantifier domain contradicts the class's own data class.
